supplementalSources.title: Carbon Core text-input guidelines
supplementalSources.method: Public-page text via web connector; not rendered measurement
supplementalSources.scope: Official product-component guidance. It does not establish the version or styling of the imported ibm.com marketing snapshot.
findings: Default input sizes are 24px (xs), 32px (sm), 40px (md/default), and 48px (lg).
Default inputs place labels outside and helper text below the field.
Documented states include enabled, active, focus, error, warning, disabled, skeleton and read-only.
Invalid state uses a red border, an error icon and an error message; this source does not specify the hex color.
Text-area minimum height is documented as 40px.
supplementalSources.version: Carbon Core, Stable, React; exact release version not identified.
limitations: Full visual tokens and rendered states were not measured. Local samples use original neutral styling and system fonts.

supplementalSources.title: Carbon for IBM.com
supplementalSources.method: Public-page text via web connector; no exact retrieval clock retained
supplementalSources.scope: Website components and styling, distinct from Carbon Core product guidance.
findings: The site defines a website-specific component and layout track.
limitations: Documentation update date is historical, not a current site implementation version.

supplementalSources.title: Carbon for IBM.com extended tabs
supplementalSources.method: Earlier public-page text pass; latest connector attempt unavailable
supplementalSources.scope: Website tab guidance with explicit version distinction.
supplementalSources.version: v1 separate extended-tabs component; v2 base Carbon tabs with editorial styling.
findings: Documentation describes auto-width labels and overflow buttons when needed at any breakpoint.
limitations: No current rendered state or exact package version verified. No tab visual metrics are copied into the snapshot.

supplementalSources.method: Public-page extracted text; no rendered browser measurement
findings: Extracted hero has two action links followed by recommendation sections.
limitations: Not a visual or responsive-layout measurement.

supplementalSources.method: Rendered page read in the dedicated cloud Chromium browser; reporting timestamp after attempt
supplementalSources.scope: Availability response only, not IBM website design evidence.

limitations: Cause unverified; not labeled bot detection. No alternate access route was tried.
